Days to weeks of offending drug initiation; muscle rigidity first
Infection; meningitis; male sex; family and personal autoimmunity history
Female sex; peripartum; weaning; infection; family and personal autoimmunity history
Fever, headache, meningeal signs; impaired consciousness, behavior disturbances, psychiatric features, movement disorders
Impaired consciousness, behavior disturbances, psychiatric features, and movement disorders
Muscle rigidity, fever, altered mental status
Negativism, functional decline, disorganized thought and behavior
Viral, fungal, or bacterial agent in CSF or serum; pleocytosis
Often but not always autoantibodies in CSF or serum; pleocytosis
